facts.text: The hotel sits in central Bangkok's key commercial and diplomatic district, next to the Erawan Shrine.
facts.excerpt: Blessed with a privileged position in the capital’s key commercial and diplomatic district, next to Erawan Shrine

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Erawan Shrine, located just outside the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel overlooks the iconic Erawan Shrine, located just outside the hotel.

facts.text: The Erawan Shrine houses the statue of Phra Phrom, the Hindu god of creation.
facts.excerpt: We’re located directly in front of the beautiful Erawan Shrine that houses the statue of Phra Phrom, the Hindu god of creation.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of multiple train stations.
facts.excerpt: We’re also within walking distance of multiple train stations to take you deeper into the heart of Bangkok.

facts.text: The i.sawan spa and club on the 5th floor is a resort-style retreat within the hotel spanning 7,000 square metres.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 5th floor, i.sawan is a resort-style retreat within the hotel, spanning 7,000 square metres.

facts.text: i.sawan features residential spa cottages, treatment bungalows, a pool, a fitness centre, a tennis court and a squash court.
facts.excerpt: The retreat features residential spa cottages, treatment bungalows, a nail bar, hair salon, pool, fitness centre, movement studio, tennis court and squash court.

facts.text: i.sawan's treatments are inspired by Thailand's ancient healing arts.
facts.excerpt: A menu of award-winning, results-oriented treatments is inspired by Thailand’s ancient healing arts.

facts.text: 24-hour butler service is available with select suites and upon request.

facts.text: The Magic Table is a dining experience led by The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping on each table.
